newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTANI RICE PRICES SEEN MIXED ON LOW DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTANI RICE PRICES SEEN MIXED ON LOW DEMAND.

text.p: Pakistani rice export prices are likely to remain mixed next week due to low demand from abroad, dealers said on Thursday.

Prices of IRRI-6 variety remained unchanged this week as foreign importers stayed away from the Pakistani market before the new crop arrival in October, an exporter said. Basmati super and ordinary basmati export prices were steady.
Pakistan exported 1.717 million tonnes of rice worth $460 million in 1996/97 (July-June), compared to 1.6 million tonnes worth $504 million in 1995/96.
In June, rice exports fell to 86,488 tonnes worth $28 million, compared to 151,568 tonnes worth $39 million in May and 347,471 tonnes worth $93 million in June 1996.
